# Gascoyne Haulage

Client of Camille, with sites gascoynehaulage.com.au and exmouthhaulage.com for two locations of the same business. In the Malbros group with [Indusolutions](indusolutions.md); the two sites are identical except text and colours, on WordPress, Elementor Pro, MetForm and FluentSMTP. First sites in WP Care, from November 2026, invoiced on 6-month terms. [email](../../sources/2026/11/2026-11-24-email-camille-gascoyne-exmouth.md) its pickup request form is the model for the Indusolutions quote form. Site care by [Madz](../people/madz.md) under [WP Care website management](../projects/wp-care-website-management.md). Introduced by [Camille Malloch](../people/camille-malloch.md).
